name: Marine Drive & Nariman Point Promenade
source: General Coastal & Monsoon Safety Precaution (BMC / Mumbai Police Advisory)
warningMessage: High waves frequently crash over the sea wall during high tide and monsoon swells. Avoid sitting on tetrapods or standing near the promenade edge during rough seas.
recommendedAction: Remain on the inner pedestrian walkway and follow local coastal police barricades.

name: Lion's Point & Tiger Point Cliff Edge
source: General Western Ghats Terrain Precaution (Pune Rural Tourist Guidance)
hazardType: Steep Unfenced Valley Drop & Dense Fog Zone
warningMessage: Steep cliff-edge drop with slippery basalt rocks and sudden low-visibility fog, particularly during the monsoon and evening hours.
recommendedAction: Stay behind safety railings, avoid cliff-edge photography, and return before sunset.

name: Arthur's Seat Savitri Gorge
source: General Hill-Station Terrain Precaution (Satara District Tourist Guidance)
warningMessage: Steep drop into the Savitri Valley with strong crosswinds and potential rockfall on approach ghat roads during heavy rain.
recommendedAction: Remain within fenced viewing platforms and check IMD ghat weather advisories before travel.

name: Baga–Calangute Coastal Stretch
source: General Beach Safety Guidance (Goa Tourism / Lifeguard Precaution)
warningMessage: Offshore rip currents can occur along this coastal belt. Entering the sea after dusk or in red-flagged zones is hazardous.
recommendedAction: Swim only between yellow-and-red lifeguard flags during daylight hours.

name: Brahmagiri Mountain Steep Steps
warningMessage: Narrow vertical rock-cut steps become slippery during rain and fog.
recommendedAction: Hold handrails firmly, wear grippy footwear, and avoid solo trekking after 5:30 PM.
